bio.text: Richard Ojeda is the Democratic nominee for North Carolina's 9th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 election, having advanced from the March 3 primary.
He was born in Rochester, Minnesota, was raised in Logan County, West Virginia, enlisted in the U.S. Army in 1989 and retired as a major in 2013 after 24 years of service.
He previously represented District 7 in the West Virginia State Senate and earned a bachelor's degree from West Virginia State in 1997.
